mission_01: Pre-emphasis uses the formula y[t] = x[t] - coeff * x[t-1] with coeff typically set to 0.97 to amplify high frequencies.
The mel scale conversion uses mel = 2595 * log10(1 + hz/700) and its inverse hz = 700 * (10^(mel/2595) - 1).
The DCT for MFCCs uses cosine basis functions: MFCC[k] = sum(log_mel[m] * cos(pi * k * (m + 0.5) / n_filters)).
